newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine electricity prices to drop seven percent.
newsitem.headline: Argentine electricity prices to drop seven percent.

text.p: Argentine wholesale electricity prices are to be lowered by seven percent from current levels in the period from August to October, the Economy Ministry said Wednesday.

The decrease comes after the quarterly electricity price evaluation carried out by the CAMMESA energy authorities. The drop represents a 29 percent decline from the same period a year earlier, the ministry said in a statement.
The ministry put the decline down to increased efficiency in the electricity generating industry and the introduction of more output at the Yacyreta hydro-electric power plant.
At the same time, demand has risen about seven percent through the year, the statement said.
